dedupe_keys.name: igb national digital geographic databases and bf cors gnss network burkina faso

description: The Geographic Institute of Burkina Faso (IGB) holds structured digital data in GIS formats for the whole country: the national topographic database (BNDT) at 1:50,000, 1:200,000 and 1:500,000, and the land cover database (BDOT) for 1992 and 2002. It also manages the BF-CORS network of permanent GNSS stations, put into service in 2011 with nine stations (Gampela, Manga, Fada, Diapaga, Dori, Ouahigouya, Dédougou, Bobo and Gaoua) funded by the Millennium Challenge Account Burkina Faso and supplied by Trimble, to tie surveying, cadastre and mapping work to the national reference system; IGB has run it since September 2012, with regional support from the Ministry of Infrastructure, and added four stations around Ouagadougou in 2018. Users register on the BF-CORS platform. The databases are obtained from IGB, and the cost and licence were not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the pages are short and in French, and the land cover data is old. Coverage is Burkina Faso. It supports hazard exposure and asset mapping of roads and settlements, and positioning infrastructure for surveying and construction; related records are the Survey of India online maps and the INEGI Mexico GNSS network.
